item.title: Show HN: What's Your AI Debt Score? Roast My Code – No AI, Just Regex
item.summary: Paste your code, get an AI Debt Score (0-100), and get roasted for your sins. 118 regex patterns, 8 languages, zero AI involved — everything runs client-side, your code never leaves your browser. Curious what score you get.
